text:
Write a story but choose one (or more) of these constraints:
  • Choose one letter and don’t include it anywhere in your story.
  • Write a story exactly 100 words long.
  • Write a story where everything happens within the space of ten minutes.
  • All the characters spend the entire story with their eyes shut.
  • You can’t use the word ‘and’ anywhere in the story.
  • Start by writing the last sentence and work backwards towards the beginning.
  • Electricity doesn’t exist in your story.
  • You can’t use any words less than four letters long.
